lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
criteria_location: Position Statement (pp.1-3): a covered-condition list, a long investigational list, and a 3-part sub-criteria block only for diabetic wounds. Session cap and documentation sit in Reimbursement Information, not the Position Statement.

logic.top_level: pathways (list of ~19 covered indications, each its own entry; only diabetic wounds has sub-criteria)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Default-deny: 'considered experimental or investigational in all other situations, including but not limited to' a long list. Chronic wounds excluded 'other than those in members with diabetes who meet the criteria specified above' (inline unless). No contraindications.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No separate repeat criteria. Reimbursement Information: 'limited to thirty (30) treatments within a 12 month period'; excess 'subject to medical review'; documentation 'should include measurable signs of healing within any 30-day period of treatment'.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Systemic hyperbaric oxygen therapy meets the definition of medical necessity for the treatment of the following conditions
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: List is implicitly any-of; 'Pre- and post-treatment ... irradiated jaw' and 'Profound anemia ... only when' mix a condition with a clause.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Member has no measurable signs of healing after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy

requirement_kinds.quote: Acute carbon monoxide poisoning; Gas gangrene; Decompression sickness ...
Nonhealing diabetic wounds of the lower extremities in members who meet the following 3 criteria
Member has a wound classified as Wagner* grade 3 or higher
no measurable signs of healing after 30 days of an adequate course of standard wound therapy
Reimbursement for HBOT (99183) is limited to thirty (30) treatments within a 12 month period.
physician initial assessment, physician history and physical, physician visit notes, and laboratory studies
wound location, size, description of wound bed and drainage
Profound anemia with exceptional blood loss: only when blood transfusion is impossible or must be delayed

thresholds.quote: limited to thirty (30) treatments within a 12 month period

time_windows.quote: no measurable signs of healing after 30 days
observations made six months or fewer before starting date of service
measurable signs of healing within any 30-day period of treatment

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: ICD-10 list is titled 'Codes That Support Medical Necessity' but is not mapped to individual conditions; ranges are broad (e.g. L97.101-L97.929 any lower-limb chronic ulcer, which would also fit conditions the text calls investigational).
codes.non_covered_code_lists: A4575 marked '(Investigational)'. Topical, limb-specific and ozone declared investigational for all indications.

external_dependencies.quote: The following National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) were reviewed on the last guideline reviewed date: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy (20.29) and Treatment of Decubitus Ulcers (270.4)

external_dependencies.what: FEP and SAO have own guidelines
external_dependencies.quote: Federal Employee Program (FEP): Follow FEP guidelines.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: grade 3- deep ulcer with abscess or osteomyelitis; grade 4- forefoot gangrene; grade 5- whole foot gangrene
Each unit billed equals one treatment, regardless of the length of time spent in the HBOT chamber.

vague_terms.quote: adequate course of standard wound therapy
vague_terms.problem: not defined; no list of components (Excellus and BCBSTX do list them)
no definition; ICD range I73.81-I73.9 includes chronic disease
'refractory' undefined, no duration of failed therapy

vague_terms.quote: Profound anemia with exceptional blood loss

extraction_hazards: Bulleted lists lose bullet glyphs in text; sub-items a/b/c are indented only
Footnote asterisk (Wagner scale) is inside the list item
Navigation tab row printed at top
Session cap and documentation requirements live outside the Position Statement
ICD-10 ranges with en dashes, multi-line groups where only the first row has a description (S-codes)
Update history mentions criteria no longer present (CRAO 2011, continuation criteria 2009)
interesting_structures: Default-deny with an explicit investigational list
Reimbursement-section cap of 30 treatments / 12 months turns repeat rules into a utilization review trigger
ICD list says 'support medical necessity' without tying to criteria
Per-session unit rule: 1 hour or 2 hours equals one 99183 unit

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = all/any/not expresses it cleanly ... 5 = needs new constructs
fit_to_tree.why: A flat any-of of indications plus one all-of of 3 leaves for diabetic wounds. Strain comes from undefined 'adequate course' and the 30-treatment cap (a count over time, not chart state).
